summary: Validates an incoming size against a stored field, resolves a source buffer pointer and size, copies the buffer into the caller-provided destination, and optionally reports the copied size back.

local_names.v4: stored/expected size read via field accessor

operations.description: v4 = FieldAccessor(this + 2): reads the stored size/limit field used for validation.
If v4 > a3, return 4: incoming size exceeds the stored field.
BufferQueryReturnPtrSizeIfValid(&v7, &a3): resolves the source pointer and the effective size.
If the buffer query fails, return 1.
Copies a3 bytes from the resolved source v7 into destination a2.
If a4 is non-null, stores the copied size v6 (a3 after the buffer query) at *a4.

unresolved: Semantic of the value read by FieldAccessor(this + 2) unknown.
Which buffer v7 aliases and how the buffer query validates its size unknown.
Return-code meanings (4, 1, 0) inferred from control flow only.
